Deepest LMS Integration

Seamlessly connects with your learning management system (LMS), so teachers can assign, collect, and review work without ever leaving their LMS platform.

Handwriting & Annotation Direct to Your LMS

Students can handwrite, draw, and annotate directly on assignments. All work is automatically saved and submitted back into the LMS — no extra steps required.

Balanced Freedom & Control

Gives students a flexible learning space while ensuring teachers maintain full visibility and classroom management.

How to Enhance Student Engagement in Canvas with Annotation Tools

Bring powerful annotation capabilities to every Canvas LMS assignment with Jotit. While Canvas supports limited markup on one assignment type, Jotit expands annotation across all formats—enabling handwriting on PDFs, highlighting, voice notes, and more. Ideal for Chromebooks and iPads, Jotit gives students tools like graph paper, music sheets, and shape recognition to deepen engagement, support executive functioning, and enhance digital learning.

FAQ

  • Jotit is a software app. It is designed for use on 2-in-1 Chromebooks, Android Tablets, and Apple iPads (November 2025 release). Jotit consolidates all a student's Google Classroom and Canvas assignments, messages, and resources into a single workspace. Students can annotate their PDFs, handwrite/type responses, and submit their work back to Google Classroom and Canvas all through the app. 

  • Getting started with Jotit is easy! Simply sign up on our website, and our team will guide you through the setup process. We'll provide training and support to ensure a smooth integration into your classroom.

  • Absolutely! Jotit is designed to support both in-person and remote learning environments. The platform's cloud-based system ensures that students and teachers can access their materials and collaborate from anywhere, at any time.

  • Jotit seamlessly integrates with popular LMS platforms like Google Classroom and Canvas, as well as other educational tools and resources. This integration ensures a smooth transition and enhances the overall learning experience.
